# E0604: version that understates its API change

A release that removes or changes what other packages use needs a new major version, and one that only adds needs a new minor one. Nothing was written to stilt.toml.

- Rule: [`versions.checked-versions`](../../reference/21-versions.md#versions.checked-versions)
- Reported at: the entry's key.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0604_understated_version`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0604_understated_version):

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn main() / io { print("app") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "app"

[dependencies]
json = { from = "file:///repos/json" }
```

The repositories it fetches from are beside it, in `E0604_understated_version.repos`.

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── VERSION THAT UNDERSTATES ITS API CHANGE ───────────── stilt.toml:5:1  [E0604]

The highest version of `json`, 1.5.0, removes `json.decode.parse_int`, which
1.4.2 has, so it needs a new major version, 2.0.0; 1.4.2 is the highest version
that checks:

  5 │ json = { from = "file:///repos/json" }
    │ ^^^^

A release that removes or changes what other packages use needs a new major
version, and one that only adds needs a new minor one. Nothing was written to
```
